notes: The prompt self-declares Horror / Multiplayer Survival / Echolocation Puzzle, and the pressure is a pursuing blind monster rather than a locked door, so Survival leads with Puzzle named second for the echolocation-labyrinth half. Escape is the matching preset and warren-looping the shape: a player fleeing a noise-hunting AI must never be cornered by a dead end, which puzzle-maze does not guarantee, so that was the close call and it stays P6 either way. Dropped the preset's building-interior because the answers put the whole round on one compact underground floor with no outside, so there is no transition to link and no P3; added spawner-npc for the monster's entry and patrol ground, hazard-kill for the traps spotted only at the last second, collectible-nodes bent to throwable decoys like rocks and alarm clocks, and spawn-protected because the monster may be player-controlled. Decided without a user that geometry rearranging mid-round is a runtime mechanic rather than a layout feature; the build is one valid loop topology that the shifting can reshuffle.
